currentEvaluation.authority: Implementation-authored regression cases, not an independent architecture-quality benchmark.

lint.comparison: Exact rc31 source snapshot versus current source using the same ESLint config. No baseline rules were raised.

limits: No rendered browser, mobile viewport, screenshot or accessibility-in-browser verification. Supported control-browser capability was unavailable; no alternative browser execution was attempted.

No live provider response or live architecture-quality comparison was completed. Hosted provider configuration exists; an authenticated customer execution path was unavailable here. Local readiness is not a diagnosis of hosted connectivity.
Synthetic provider responses establish protocol and guard behavior only; numerical quality scores from them are not model performance evidence.
Current verification recorded means a current human-reviewed record and its captured basis. AIW did not independently execute or certify external tests.
One explicit native target per proposed operation; additional proposed objects stay visible as remaining design scope.
The six-family coverage and inspected product-version interpretations are bounded; complete provider/version and cross-pattern coverage remains explicit in ARCHITECTURE-EXECUTION-COVERAGE.md.
